svg.aria-label: A mallard's day in four panels, 80 percent. Dawn: fly to a cut grain field to feed. Midday: rest on a marsh or raft on open water. Late day: back to the field to feed. Night: marsh or creek to roost. Legal hours for ducks: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset, 99 percent. Wigeon raft offshore until late afternoon, 80 percent. After a cold front with a north wind, hunt the next morning, 65 percent.
svg.text: Wigeon raft offshore until late afternoon (80%)
Cold front, north wind: hunt the next morning (65%)
